description: Enerdata offers the Oil Refineries in America | America Refineries Dataset as a one-time regional export in its energy dataset catalogue. The delivered spreadsheet lists refinery country, name, company, new or built status, commissioning or decommissioning year, atmospheric distillation capacity in barrels per day, investment, shareholders and technical comments. Enerdata states that the dataset is updated quarterly. These asset and capacity fields support refinery capacity planning and representations of fuel supply systems. The vendor defines the covered country list; region names do not establish complete continental coverage. Access requires paid purchase through the provider; no purchase was made. The exact delivered file extension, measurement coverage dates and contractual licence were not established from the metadata reviewed. Caveats include changing project status and the distinction between a purchased export and the broader subscription service described on the page. Related records include the Enerdata hydrogen and derivatives projects database, a separate product with different infrastructure scope.
